changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO medical_investigation (clinic_id, name) SELECT c.id, i.name FROM clinic c CROSS JOIN ( -- Hematology SELECT 'CBC' AS name UNION ALL SELECT 'ESR' UNION ALL SELECT 'Peripheral smear' UNION ALL SELECT 'Platelet count' UNION ALL SELECT 'Reticulocyte count' UNION ALL -- Biochemistry SELECT 'FBS' UNION ALL SELECT 'PPBS' UNION ALL SELECT 'RBS' UNION ALL SELECT 'HbA1c' UNION ALL SELECT 'Lipid profile' UNION ALL SELECT 'LFT' UNION ALL SELECT 'KFT/RFT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Serum electrolytes' UNION ALL SELECT 'Serum uric acid' UNION ALL SELECT 'Serum calcium' UNION ALL SELECT 'Serum phosphorus' UNION ALL SELECT 'Vitamin D' UNION ALL SELECT 'Vitamin B12' UNION ALL SELECT 'Iron studies' UNION ALL SELECT 'Ferritin' UNION ALL -- Endocrine SELECT 'TSH' UNION ALL SELECT 'T3' UNION ALL SELECT 'T4' UNION ALL SELECT 'Free T3 / Free T4' UNION ALL SELECT 'Cortisol' UNION ALL SELECT 'PSA' UNION ALL -- Cardiac SELECT 'Troponin' UNION ALL SELECT 'CK-MB' UNION ALL SELECT 'NT-proBNP' UNION ALL SELECT 'D-dimer' UNION ALL -- Coag SELECT 'PT/INR' UNION ALL SELECT 'APTT' UNION ALL -- Urine SELECT 'Urine routine' UNION ALL SELECT 'Urine microalbumin' UNION ALL SELECT 'Urine culture' UNION ALL -- Stool SELECT 'Stool routine' UNION ALL SELECT 'Stool occult blood' UNION ALL -- Microbiology SELECT 'Blood culture' UNION ALL SELECT 'Throat swab culture' UNION ALL SELECT 'Sputum culture' UNION ALL SELECT 'Sputum AFB' UNION ALL -- Serology SELECT 'HIV' UNION ALL SELECT 'HBsAg' UNION ALL SELECT 'HCV' UNION ALL SELECT 'Dengue NS1 / IgM / IgG' UNION ALL SELECT 'Malaria smear' UNION ALL SELECT 'Widal' UNION ALL SELECT 'CRP' UNION ALL SELECT 'RA factor' UNION ALL SELECT 'ANA' UNION ALL -- Imaging SELECT 'X-ray Chest' UNION ALL SELECT 'X-ray Abdomen' UNION ALL SELECT 'X-ray Spine' UNION ALL SELECT 'X-ray KUB' UNION ALL SELECT 'USG Abdomen' UNION ALL SELECT 'USG Pelvis' UNION ALL SELECT 'USG Whole Abdomen' UNION ALL SELECT 'Doppler' UNION ALL SELECT 'CT Brain' UNION ALL SELECT 'CT Chest' UNION ALL SELECT 'CT Abdomen' UNION ALL SELECT 'MRI Brain' UNION ALL SELECT 'MRI Spine' UNION ALL SELECT 'Mammography' UNION ALL -- Cardiology SELECT 'ECG' UNION ALL SELECT '2D Echo' UNION ALL SELECT 'TMT' UNION ALL SELECT 'Holter monitor' UNION ALL -- Pulmonary SELECT 'PFT / Spirometry' UNION ALL SELECT 'ABG' UNION ALL -- Other SELECT 'EEG' UNION ALL SELECT 'NCV / EMG' UNION ALL SELECT 'Endoscopy (Upper GI)' UNION ALL SELECT 'Colonoscopy' UNION ALL SELECT 'Biopsy' UNION ALL SELECT 'Pap smear' UNION ALL SELECT 'PAP & HPV' UNION ALL SELECT 'Bone densitometry (DEXA)' UNION ALL SELECT 'Audiometry' UNION ALL SELECT 'Eye refraction' UNION ALL SELECT 'Fundus exam' ) i WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM medical_investigation mi WHERE mi.clinic_id = c.id AND LOWER(mi.name) = LOWER(i.name) );
